text: An active member submits and reads their own requests; disabled membership prevents new business actions.
criteria: Member reads own request; another member's request and a removed member's new submission are denied.

text: Coordinators assign/resolve only their organization's work; mutation uses expected versions.
criteria: Concurrent coordinator updates with one version produce one accepted new state; stale mutation conflicts.

text: Only organization administrators change membership/settings; no user can grant their own role by editing a payload.
criteria: Body-injected administrator role or another org's administrator identity cannot grant membership privileges.

text: Record attributable state changes and preserve configuration separation between local/test and release environments.
criteria: Inspect accepted change attribution and deploy identical candidate code with distinct reviewed test/release configuration.

text: For the two-tenant extension, data, indexes, idempotency keys, background work and client caches preserve organization scope even with colliding local IDs.
criteria: With colliding IDs, test detail/list/index/retry/cache paths across both tenants; no cross-scope content or duplicate-key collision.

text: With two organizations of 100 users and 500 requests each, pass every isolation test and measure the shared metadata target.
criteria: Execute two-tenant workload and isolation suite; retain denied responses and database-level checks, not only UI screenshots.
